description: This file implements the authentication page component for a React application using Next.js. It provides sign-in and user creation forms with form handling, validation, API interactions, and user feedback banners.

classes.name: ErrorBanner
classes.description: Component for displaying error messages to the user.

classes.name: SuccessBanner
classes.description: Component for displaying success messages to the user.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Reusable component for rendering labeled input fields with icons.

classes.name: RoleBadge
classes.description: Displays a badge indicating the user's role with styling.

classes.name: AuthPage
classes.description: Main React component rendering the authentication interface with login and signup functionalities.

methods.name: classNames
methods.description: Utility to concatenate class names conditionally.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Converts various error types into user-readable message strings.

methods.name: onLogin
methods.description: Handles login form submission; calls API and manages UI state.

methods.name: onSignup
methods.description: Handles user registration; calls backend API to create user and manages state.
